planets.name: TOI-1260 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-1260 with a 3.13-day year, found in 2021.

text.card: TOI-1260 b was found in 2021 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 3 planets known around TOI-1260. Its orbit and size follow Lam et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
